extracted.name: Baby Back Ribs
extracted.description: Rub has a little coffee in it!
ingredient_lines: 1 slab baby back ribs (remove membrane from back)
1 tbsp your favorite all seasoning. (I use bull- _ _ _ t that’s the name)
instruction_lines: Remove membrane and cover with a light coat of Dijon mustard. Mix all ingredients in small bowl and rub on both sides of ribs and place in refrigerator till ready to cook.
I used a pellet grill heat at 250. Smoke for two hours, then I covered with my favorite barbecue sauce Hill Country and smoked another 2 1/2 hours. Pulls right off the bone. Enjoy!
